systems.system: National Property Identification System (National Property ID)
systems.owner: Egyptian government entities, under Law 88 of 2025 per other documents
systems.tiers: government entities, utilities, municipalities, taxation authorities

note: Property ID is a one-sector identifier; the article names no law or decree on public bodies sharing data, only Real Estate Registration Law 114 of 1946 amended by Law 9 of 2022, a registration law.
